name: 青岚修仙 · 国风插图
description: 人物、山门、洞府、坊市与斗法的统一国风绘画风格；按场景生成单幅插图。
prompt: Create one original traditional Chinese cultivation-fiction illustration. Use refined painterly linework, layered ink-wash atmosphere and restrained mineral colors: jade greens, warm stone, indigo cloth and small cinnabar accents. Preserve the supplied character age, appearance, clothing, equipment and cultivation level. Give the requested action one readable focal point and spatially coherent foreground, middle ground and background. Show lived-in wooden halls, stone paths, practical cloth robes, worn tools and materials appropriate to the actual location; low-level disciples should look materially modest. Spiritual effects must express the specified technique and realm, without obscuring faces, hands or the decisive action. Choose the single moment requested; if none is selected, choose one visually clear moment without revealing an undisclosed identity or future twist. Depict only characters, creatures and objects established by the prompt. No captions, written talismans, logos, watermarks, collage, modern machinery, random floating swords or invented religious symbols.
